description: This Java source file defines the ArtifactInfoFactory class in the org.apache.ofbiz.webtools.artifactinfo package. The class manages retrieval and caching of various artifact information objects within the OFBiz framework, such as entities, services, forms, screens, and controller mappings. It provides methods to load, cache, and access metadata about different components of the OFBiz system, facilitating analysis and visualization of the artifact dependencies.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoFactory
classes.description: A singleton factory class responsible for managing and retrieving metadata artifacts within the OFBiz framework. It handles caching, loading, and accessing details about entities, services, forms, screens, and controllers, providing foundational support for artifact analysis and dependency visualization.

methods.name: getArtifactInfoFactory
methods.description: Retrieves a cached instance of ArtifactInfoFactory for the specified delegator name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: prepareAll
methods.description: Loads all artifact information objects, including entities, services, and components, populating internal caches.

methods.name: getEntityModelReader
methods.description: Returns the ModelReader instance used for entity metadata.

methods.name: getDispatchContext
methods.description: Returns the DispatchContext associated with this factory.

methods.name: getModelEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the model entity for a given entity name.

methods.name: getModelService
methods.description: Retrieves the model service for a given service name.

methods.name: getModelForm
methods.description: Loads a form model from a location or by name.

methods.name: getModelScreen
methods.description: Loads a screen model given its name and location.

methods.name: getControllerRequestMap
methods.description: Retrieves the controller request mapping for a given URL and request URI.

methods.name: getControllerViewMap
methods.description: Retrieves the controller view mapping for a given URL and view URI.

methods.name: getEntityArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gets or creates the EntityArtifactInfo object for a specified entity.

methods.name: getServiceArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gets or creates the ServiceArtifactInfo object for a specified service.

methods.name: getServiceEcaArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gets or creates the ServiceEcaArtifactInfo object for a specified ECA rule.

methods.name: getFormWidgetArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gets or creates the FormWidgetArtifactInfo object based on form name and location.

methods.name: getScreenWidgetArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gets or creates the ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo object based on screen name and location.

methods.name: getControllerRequestArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gets or creates the ControllerRequestArtifactInfo object based on controller URL and request URI.

methods.name: getControllerViewArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gets or creates the ControllerViewArtifactInfo object based on controller URL and view URI.

methods.name: getArtifactInfoByUniqueIdAndType
methods.description: Retrieves artifact info by a combined unique identifier and type.

methods.name: getArtifactInfoByNameAndType
methods.description: Retrieves artifact info by name, location, and type, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getAllArtifactInfosByNamePartial
methods.description: Searches for all artifact info objects matching a partial name, filtered by type.
